claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Witness photos show blue cylindrical industrial steel tanks/drums with bolted circular end caps and central ports—metal gas/tank style, not plastic, and not shown as general-purpose plastic liquid drums.

risks.risk: Unknown contents/rating (could be for specific gas/liquid and not safe for general storage)
risks.proof: Clear photo of any stamped/printed specification plate or markings on the tank body/end cap (contents, pressure rating, standard), plus a close-up of the central port/label text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unverified industrial tanks with unknown suitability; treated as worst-case for general liquid storage (buyer risk) and priced low accordingly.

risks.risk: Leak risk / valve/port integrity (central opening and seams may leak even if exterior looks worn)
risks.proof: Video clip showing the port/valve area with any valve/regulator removed/accessible, and a simple leak test evidence (e.g., soapy water on joints/valve area) or a recent inspection certificate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially leaking/needs servicing (not guaranteed airtight); buyer assumes repair/testing cost.

risks.risk: Structural integrity affected by dents/scratches/rust (could be unsafe for pressure or reuse)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of dents, seam edges, and rust spots with a ruler/scale, plus underside/base and full circumference views; ideally a professional thickness/condition report.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/possibly compromised condition (worst-case) based on visible oxidation and dents.

risks.risk: Internal corrosion/contamination (photos only show exterior; internal lining may be degraded)
risks.proof: Photo/video through the central port showing internal condition (rusting, pitting, residue) and whether it has been cleaned/neutralized.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not cleaned/unknown internal condition; treated as for scrap or after cleaning/inspection only.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (valves/regulators/hoses/caps) affecting usability and transport
risks.proof: Photo inventory of included parts: valves, caps, regulators, protective covers, and any hoses/hoses ends; show what is present on at least one tank end.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as sold without guaranteed accessories; buyer must source replacements.

risks.risk: Capacity/dimensions unknown (affects value and transport cost)
risks.proof: Photos of height/diameter measurements or stamped capacity markings; include a tape measure in-frame.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case assumption of smaller/unknown capacity and higher transport handling uncertainty.

proof_requests: Send clear close-ups of any stamped markings/labels on each tank end and body (contents, capacity, pressure rating, serial/standard).
Provide a short video showing the central port/valve area and any valve condition (open/closed) and the seam/edge condition.
Show internal condition through the port (video or photos) and confirm whether tanks are empty/cleaned.
Provide evidence of inspection/testing/certification and service history (documents or stamped dates).
Confirm what accessories are included (valves/regulators/caps/protective covers) and show them in photos.
response.reason: The witness confirms industrial steel tank/cylinder style with visible wear, but key pricing drivers (capacity/rating, leak/valve condition, internal corrosion, and included accessories) are not verifiable from the provided shots. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
